run_xlm_training: run XLM language transfer training with multi-GPU distributed mode and configurable tasks
build_xlm_model: build an XLM Transformer model with encoder-only or encoder-decoder architecture
load_xlm_data: load multilingual data from disk with configurable vocabulary and language sampling
evaluate_xlm_model: evaluate XLM model on perplexity and BLEU metrics across multiple languages
configure_xlm_parser: configure an argparse parser with all XLM training, model, data, and evaluation parameters
